property.title: Rosewood House
property.summary: A detached three-bedroom house with a driveway and an enclosed rear garden, on a residential street.
property.imageAlt: The covered front porch of a single-storey house with cream board-and-batten siding, white tapered columns on stone pedestals, a stone porch base and steps, a bank of white-mullioned windows, two dark wicker chairs and a mown lawn.
